changed: Codex review round 4 on H4, eight findings fixed with regression tests: quote-aware command splitting and shell continuation handling; variables in command position, eval/source anywhere, git submodule foreach and bisect run, non-safe git reset options, docker exec running git/docker/shell -c, exported or inherited docker endpoints, and compose beyond allowed lifecycle subcommands now ask; literal punctuation passes; new-task honours an open or reopened record. eng-session states bash-guard's threat model.

rulings.ruling: bash-guard is scoped as a guard against habitual commands, not a sandbox; deliberate obfuscation and commands inside scripts are out of reach of any text inspection, so unattended runs need Claude Code sandboxing or a container without the Docker socket and push credentials
rulings.cost_if_wrong: an obfuscated or scripted command in an attended session reaches the permission rules and the owner

rulings.ruling: An interactive shell inside an allowed container passes; only a nested git, docker or shell -c asks
rulings.cost_if_wrong: commands typed inside that shell are not inspected (they run inside the sandbox container)
